svg.title: 3. Hybrid DNS
svg.text: One name space, three resolvers: Route 53 Resolver, Cloud DNS and on-prem DNS
Resolver rules, shared with AWS RAM
Cloud Router to AWS, route it
1 EKS asks VPC resolver, rule sends gcp.corp.example out
2 Outbound endpoint queries Cloud DNS inbound policy IPs
3 GKE query follows the peering zone to the DNS hub
4 Forwarding zone queries the Route 53 inbound endpoint
